decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the infrastructure channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.
notes: The corroborating view is infrastructure rather than telemetry. This is the rented-account shape: the genuine store keeps trading, so the payment mixture stays near the category baseline and telemetry alone never crosses its threshold.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100034 declared electronics_retail at onboarding 262 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the electronics_retail baseline are round_share_drift at +3.8 sigma (observed 0.0822 against a category baseline of 0.00056), refund_rate at +3.3 sigma (observed 0.143 against a category baseline of 0.0598), night_share at +1.0 sigma (observed 0.208 against a category baseline of 0.122). The checkout surface presents a crypto_exchange interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of electronics_retail. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Linked to 6 other merchants by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle. Their payment behaviour is also moving in step (synchrony 0.52), which independent businesses do not do. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. It is linked to 6 other merchant accounts by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle, and those accounts are moving in step (synchrony 0.52). Asked directly, the merchant restated its declared business. In total 3 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the infrastructure channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
